annotations.title: Deal alert link for a show on TIX

description: Get a link the person can open to sign up for TIX email alerts about a show: deals and presales for that show, plus offers in their state. The link opens the sign-up on the TIX show page, where they enter their own email and confirm; they can unsubscribe at any time. Use it when someone asks to hear about a deal or presale for a show.

show.description: TIX show page URL (from search_shows), its slug, or the show name.
